cd ~/psychology-institute-platform

# 1) Pull latest code
git pull

# 2) Rebuild images
docker compose -f dependencies/docker-compose.yml build

# 3) Start/update containers
docker compose -f dependencies/docker-compose.yml up -d

# 4) Run DB migrations
docker compose -f dependencies/docker-compose.yml exec backend \
  python dependencies/manage.py migrate

# 5) Quick health checks
docker compose -f dependencies/docker-compose.yml ps
curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3010/health



# 6)Restart app stack:
sudo systemctl restart psychology-docker.service
# 7) Restart nginx only:
sudo systemctl restart nginx
# 8) Check containers:
docker compose -f ~/psychology-institute-platform/dependencies/docker-compose.yml ps
# 9) Follow app logs:
docker compose -f ~/psychology-institute-platform/dependencies/docker-compose.yml logs -f

docker compose -f ~/psychology-institute-platform/dependencies/docker-compose.yml logs -f backend
docker compose -f ~/psychology-institute-platform/dependencies/docker-compose.yml logs -f frontend


# see if it is enabled/running
sudo systemctl status psychology-docker.service

# start (boot the Docker containers)
sudo systemctl start psychology-docker.service

# stop (usually docker compose down)
sudo systemctl stop psychology-docker.service

# apply a restart after code/image changes
sudo systemctl restart psychology-docker.service

# start automatically on reboot
sudo systemctl enable psychology-docker.service

# disable autostart
sudo systemctl disable psychology-docker.service
